resources.string: Screen Clicker performs automatic taps on the point you select. It does not read screen content.
Accessibility service: DISABLED – enable \"Screen Clicker\" in Accessibility settings.
Enable the Screen Clicker accessibility service first.
Open the target app, drag the target if needed and press Start.

How to use:
1. Enable the accessibility service.
2. Pick the screen profile your coordinates come from (or "This device"), enter X/Y and the tap rate.
3. Press "Save & show floating controls".
4. Open the app you want to tap, drag the blue target onto the exact spot if needed and press Start. Press Stop to finish.
